analyst.text: Philadelphia lose Jaylen Brown to a left hamstring strain after he scored 31 in each of his last two games; he will be re-evaluated before Saturday. LeBron James and Joel Embiid are expected to play, while Orlando are still without Paolo Banchero and Jonathan Isaac but have won four straight. With Brown out, the angle leans slightly towards Orlando.
